name: phone
description: bia's own phone line when bia runs on a phone: SMS in and out (chats phone:<number>), phone calls (ring, answer, reject, place), USSD codes, the line's status (SIM, carrier, roaming, signal), the phone's Wi-Fi (list, join, forget: Android owns it, not nmcli) and its Wi-Fi hotspot (on/off, name, password, a QR code to join it). Incoming SMS arrive like other chats; say(channel='phone:+34…') sends an SMS. An incoming call arrives as [incoming call]; a missed one as [missed call]. In a call bia hears the other side (their speech arrives as messages on the phone:<number> chat) and say() on that chat speaks into the call, as in WhatsApp calls; text spoken in a call is not also sent as SMS. On this phone, machine poweroff and reboot switch off or restart the phone itself (Android shuts down cleanly; bia comes back with it on a reboot). Starts by itself when the bia app on the phone has linked the line (files/phone/link.json).
examples: +34625640810|phone:+34625640810|<issued>|<delivered>|hi, are you there? -> say(identity='+34625640810', channel='phone:+34625640810', message='Yes, here!')
root|console|<issued>|<delivered>|text my wife +34600000000 that I am late -> say(identity='+34600000000', channel='phone:+34600000000', message='I am running late.', new_chat=true)
root|console|<issued>|<delivered>|is the SIM in roaming? -> phone_status()
+34625640810|phone:+34625640810|<issued>|<delivered>|[speech en] hello, can you hear me? -> say(identity='+34625640810', channel='phone:+34625640810', message='Yes, I hear you!')
root|web|<issued>|<delivered>|connect to the cafe wifi CafeNet, password latte2024 -> phone_wifi_connect(ssid='CafeNet', password='latte2024')
root|web|<issued>|<delivered>|which wifi networks are around? -> phone_wifi_list()

root|telegram:12345|<issued>|<delivered>|turn on the hotspot and send me the QR -> phone_hotspot(on=true), then say(channel='telegram:12345', message='Hotspot bia is on, password …', files=['/home/bia/files/phone/hotspot-qr.png'])
root|web|<issued>|<delivered>|set hotspot password to sunny-day-42 -> phone_hotspot(password='sunny-day-42')
